title: S7 Asset and Lifecycle Schema Governance Fields

entries.name: Stable schema identity
entries.requirement: Each governed asset or lifecycle schema shall have a stable identifier that can be referenced from project deliverables and validation evidence.

entries.name: Schema name
entries.requirement: Each schema shall have a human-readable name that identifies the structured handover or lifecycle information it governs.

entries.name: Purpose or intended lifecycle use
entries.requirement: The lifecycle process or downstream use supported by the schema shall be declared explicitly.

entries.name: Standard, client, or governed origin
entries.requirement: The schema shall identify whether its authority originates from an industry standard, client requirement, governed enterprise template, or other approved source.

entries.name: Authoritative schema artifact
entries.requirement: The authoritative JSON, spreadsheet, database, specification, or other governed schema artifact shall be referenced rather than duplicating full field lists in S7 doctrine.

entries.name: Schema status
entries.requirement: Each schema shall carry a governed lifecycle status such as draft, approved, deprecated, or superseded.

entries.name: Schema version
entries.requirement: Each schema shall carry an identifiable version so project teams can state which version applies to a handover obligation.

entries.name: Field groups or domains
entries.requirement: The schema shall identify the principal information domains it governs, such as asset identity, location, classification, performance, maintenance, warranty, or other approved domains.

entries.name: Minimum required information basis
entries.requirement: The schema shall define or reference its minimum required fields or required information categories without relying on undocumented project assumptions.

entries.name: Optional or client extension policy
entries.requirement: The schema shall identify how optional or client-specific extensions are activated and how deviations from the base schema are recorded.

entries.name: Schema change control
entries.requirement: The route for proposing, reviewing, approving, and communicating schema changes shall be identifiable.

entries.name: Validation method
entries.requirement: The schema shall declare or reference the validation approach for completeness, valid values, classifications, and required relationships.

entries.name: Validation evidence artifacts
entries.requirement: Expected validation reports, QA logs, exported datasets, or equivalent evidence shall be identifiable.

entries.name: Exception or deviation route
entries.requirement: Missing information, approved exceptions, and client-specific departures shall be traceable through a governed deviation route.

entries.name: Project applicability reference
entries.requirement: Projects shall identify which governed schema and version applies in the BEP or equivalent project instrument; project population remains separate from this registry.

non_promoted_source_content: Example schema IDs and names from the source scaffold are illustrative only.
No COBie field list, client-proprietary asset template, or client-specific acceptance rule is promoted by this registry.
Actual project population of lifecycle schemas remains a project execution obligation.

provenance.migration_note: Migrated the governance scaffold into machine-readable schema-catalogue fields without embedding full COBie/client field lists or project-specific asset data.
